preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdin contains exactly one token (no extra whitespace).

preconditions.expression: T := int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all((line := stdin.splitlines()[1 + 3 * i].strip()) and line.isdigit() and (N := int(line)) >= 3 and N <= 1000 for i in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case i (0 ≤ i < T), the first line after the test case header is an integer N (3 ≤ N ≤ 1000) representing the length of S and P.

preconditions.expression: all((S := stdin.splitlines()[2 + 3 * i].strip()) and all(c in '01' for c in S) and len(S) == N for i in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case i, the second line is a binary string S of length N.

preconditions.expression: all((P := stdin.splitlines()[3 + 3 * i].strip()) and all(c in '01' for c in P) and len(P) == N for i in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case i, the third line is a binary string P of length N.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (all(S[i] == P[i] for i in range(N)) or (sum(S) != sum(P) and (sum(S) == N or sum(P) == N or sum(S) == 0 or sum(P) == 0))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if S can be transformed into P using the allowed operations, otherwise 'NO'. The transformation is possible if either S is already equal to P, or the sums of 1s in S and P differ and at least one of S or P is all 0s or all 1s (allowing the operation to adjust the sum).
